description: Use this when the user asks what an employee costs the employer in a country beyond the gross salary: employer social security contributions, payroll taxes, pension, health or accident insurance, mandatory levies, or the total cost of employment (e.g. "how much does it cost to employ a developer in Germany at 80k", "employer charges in Spain", "coût employeur d'un salarié en Pologne"). Returns each statutory employer contribution with its rate, base, ceiling, source (official wherever one exists) and check date, then the monthly and annual total and its percent of gross, before any Employer of Record fee. A total the country declares as a floor or a ceiling is written "at least" or "at most". A monthly salary is passed as the user gives it, with salary_period "month": the country's statutory 13th or 14th month is then applied (e.g. "a hire at 4,000 a month in Madrid", "un salarié payé 2 500 par mois à Lisbonne"). When the user asks for the full cost through an Employer of Record and has been quoted its fees, pass them as the user gives them (eor_fee_monthly, eor_one_time_fees, deposit): the answer keeps the statutory cost, the fees entered by the user and their total apart, and the deposit out of the total. EOR Scope holds no provider fee: without the user's figures, the answer stays statutory, and eor_fee_sources says where each provider publishes its fees. Do not use for an employee's net pay or income tax or for legal advice. Amounts given in the local currency come back in it, with the USD in brackets. Data snapshot 2026-11-06. Cost comparison, not legal or tax advice.

assumptions.description: Override an adjustable assumption the country declares, e.g. {"basic_share_of_gross": 0.6}. See `assumptions` in an employer_cost answer.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("DE") or country name ("Germany")

deposit.description: A deposit the user was quoted: shown apart, never added to the cost

amount.description: Deposit or reserve the user was asked for

currency.description: USD, or the local currency of the country

eor_fee_monthly.description: The Employer of Record fee the user was quoted, per employee per month, in fees_currency. Only a figure the user gives.

eor_one_time_fees.description: One-time fees the user was quoted (onboarding, set-up), in total for this employee, in fees_currency. Only a figure the user gives.

fees_currency.description: Currency of eor_fee_monthly and eor_one_time_fees: USD, or the local currency of the country

include_notes.description: Include the long legal note behind each line

payments_per_year.description: With salary_period "month" only: the total number of monthly salaries the contract pays in a year, statutory ones included (e.g. 14). Omit to use the statutory number of the country.

salary.description: Gross salary, a year unless salary_period is "month". Omit to use the country's example salary.

salary_currency.description: Currency of `salary`: USD, or the local currency of the country

salary_period.description: Whether the salary is a year (default) or a month. Pass a monthly salary as the user gives it, with "month": the statutory number of monthly payments of the country (13th, 14th month) is applied, see salary_basis in the answer.

name: employer_cost
title: Employer cost of an employee in a country
